#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RELEASE_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

release=$1
case "$release" in
    /*) release_path=$release ;;
    *)  release_path=$base/$release ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$release_path" ]; then
    printf 'publish: release directory not found: %s\n' "$release" >&2
    exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$release_path/MANIFEST" ]; then
    printf 'publish: refusing release without MANIFEST: %s\n' "$release" >&2
    exit 1
fi

tmp=$base/.current.$$
if ! ln -s -- "$release" "$tmp"; then
    printf 'publish: cannot create temporary current link\n' >&2
    exit 1
fi
trap 'rm -f -- "$tmp"' EXIT HUP INT TERM

# Same-directory rename is atomic: readers see either the old complete
# release or the new complete release, never a missing current path.
mv -Tf -- "$tmp" "$base/current"
trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
PUBLISH_EOF
chmod 755 "$new"

printf '%s\n' '--- installed publisher ---'

sed -n '1,240p' "$script"

command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/atomic-release-publication
publish=$base/bin/publish
printf '%s\n' '--- rejection test ---'
before=$(readlink "$base/current")
if "$publish" releases/incomplete >/tmp/publish-reject.out 2>&1; then
  printf '%s\n' 'ERROR: incomplete release was accepted'
  exit 1
fi
after=$(readlink "$base/current")
printf 'before=%s after=%s rejection=' "$before" "$after"
cat /tmp/publish-reject.out
[ "$before" = "$after" ]

printf '%s\n' '--- concurrent atomicity stress ---'
: > /tmp/publish-reader-errors
reader() {
  i=0
  while [ "$i" -lt 2500 ]; do
    [ -L "$base/current" ] || printf 'current-not-link iteration=%s\n' "$i" >> /tmp/publish-reader-errors
    target=$(readlink "$base/current" 2>/dev/null) || {
      printf 'current-unreadable iteration=%s\n' "$i" >> /tmp/publish-reader-errors
      i=$((i + 1))
      continue
    }
    case "$target" in
      releases/one|releases/two) ;;
      *) printf 'unexpected-target=%s iteration=%s\n' "$target" "$i" >> /tmp/publish-reader-errors ;;
    esac
    [ -s "$base/$target/MANIFEST" ] || printf 'missing-MANIFEST target=%s iteration=%s\n' "$target" "$i" >> /tmp/publish-reader-errors
    [ -s "$base/$target/index.txt" ] || printf 'missing-index target=%s iteration=%s\n' "$target" "$i" >> /tmp/publish-reader-errors
    i=$((i + 1))
  done
}
reader & r1=$!
reader & r2=$!
reader & r3=$!
reader & r4=$!
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 300 ]; do
  "$publish" releases/two
  "$publish" releases/one
  i=$((i + 1))
done
wait "$r1" "$r2" "$r3" "$r4"
"$publish" releases/two
errors=$(wc -l < /tmp/publish-reader-errors)
printf 'reader_checks=%s publish_switches=%s errors=%s final_target=%s\n' 10000 601 "$errors" "$(readlink "$base/current")"
if [ "$errors" -ne 0 ]; then
  sed -n '1,40p' /tmp/publish-reader-errors
  exit 1
fi

printf '%s\n' '--- release preservation and rollback ---'
for release in one two incomplete; do

  printf '\n'
done
"$publish" releases/one
printf 'rollback_one=%s manifest=%s' "$(readlink "$base/current")" "$(cat "$base/current/MANIFEST")"
"$publish" releases/two
printf 'rollback_two=%s manifest=%s' "$(readlink "$base/current")" "$(cat "$base/current/MANIFEST")"
